description: This Java source file defines a mock factory class 'MockHiveMqtt5ClientFactory' used for testing MQTT client interactions with HiveMQ in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to simulate MQTT client behavior, handle connections, publish messages, subscribe to topics, and simulate connection errors, primarily for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: MockHiveMqtt5ClientFactory
classes.description: A mock factory class for creating simulated MQTT clients for testing HiveMQ MQTT interactions.

methods.name: withException
methods.description: Configures the factory to throw an exception during client connection.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Adds an MQTT publish message to the internal message store for a specific topic.

methods.name: withMessages
methods.description: Adds multiple MQTT publish messages to the internal message store.

methods.name: withTestProbe
methods.description: Sets an ActorRef probe to receive messages published by the client.

methods.name: withFailingSubscribe
methods.description: Configures the subscribe operation to fail with an exception.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that the disconnect method was called on all mock clients.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked MQTT asynchronous client, with behavior based on the current configuration.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for configuring MQTT clients, returning a mocked builder with predefined behaviors.
